prompt: Why does the form ask a visitor to identify the side they used for certain entries?
promptZh: 為什麼有些參賽作品的選票會要求遊客填寫觀覽的那一側？

options.text: To check if the visitor entered through the west gate
options.zh: 查核遊客是不是從西側入口入場
options.whyZh: 詢問的是看作品的那一側，不是入場大門的位置。

options.text: To count how many visitors watched the repair teams
options.zh: 計算有多少遊客觀看修補工作
options.whyZh: 投票欄記側面和喜歡的造型，不記是否看了修補工作。

options.text: To require that all voters see the work from both sides
options.zh: 要求所有投票者先從兩側看過
options.whyZh: 公告明說不用從兩側都看過；只須記下實際看的一側。

options.text: To connect a shape preference with the viewpoint that produced it
options.zh: 把遊客偏好的造型與他們看作品的位置連在一起
options.whyZh: 這幾座沙雕從兩側看差別很大；一同填側面與喜歡的造型，才能知道那個偏好針對哪個視角看到的外形。

explanationZh: 這幾座沙雕從兩側看差別很大；一同填側面與喜歡的造型，才能知道那個偏好針對哪個視角看到的外形。
evidence: The shapes of three entries look very different from their two marked sides / choose the side you looked from, then mark the shape you liked

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The shapes of three entries look very different from their two marked sides
choose the side you looked from, then mark the shape you liked
